changes.summary: Declared explicit recipe alignment metadata; no runtime behavior changed.
Recorded the exact TP2 checkpoint lower bound and the fleet-fit GLM alternative.
changes.details: The exact TP3 contract is unsupported on the current one- or two-Spark configuration. Half of the immutable 292,599,148,533-byte snapshot is already 146.3 GB per rank before KV cache and runtime memory, so no safe TP2 variant can fit the roughly 126.9 GB-per-node inventory. The TP3 contract remains installable; the 126 GB-envelope GLM 5.3 EXL3 DFlash2 TP2 recipe is the current alternative.

changes.summary: Closed the exact model inventory against all 751 pinned snapshot files.
changes.details: Added the 603 Terminal-Bench trace files previously omitted from the model entity, reconciling the 83,970,453-byte difference without changing the installed snapshot, runtime, or adapter.

changes.summary: Marked the exact TP3 contract unavailable on the current two-Spark fleet.
changes.details: The executable historical contract is preserved for a future three-Spark canary. GLM 5.3 Flash NVFP4 dual is identified as the deployable fleet alternative; runtime and artifacts are unchanged.

changes.summary: Declared the complete recipe contract installable without changing Candidate qualification.
changes.details: The execution contract was already structurally complete; this release makes it available for explicit operator installation while physical build and Spark acceptance remain separate.

changes.summary: Enabled strict-harness TP3 execution with Mia's official Ray topology and complete vision, DCP, KV, expert-routing, reasoning, MTP, and CUDA-graph flags.
Moved the official NCCL 2.30.7 preload into the adapter build using the exact PyPI ARM64 wheel and SHA-256, eliminating the host-staged runtime dependency.
Added build-time Ray/vLLM verification and fail-closed rendezvous checks; Candidate now denotes only the pending physical canary.
Pinned the current c5d93567 checkpoint inventory; all weight, vision, tokenizer, configuration, and runtime files remain byte-identical.
changes.details: The upstream revision adds 603 Terminal-Bench trace files and updates README.md, increasing the exact snapshot by 83,971,638 bytes without changing any runtime-affecting payload.

changes.summary: Retained the Candidate Mia TP3 runtime and topology patch because the checkpoint's executable payload is unchanged.
Added allowlisted sparse-indexer and chat-template settings and recorded the remaining TP3 launch requirements blocked by the strict harness.
Initial reviewed catalog release of GLM 5.2 AQLM three Sparks.
